selection: Three Packagist-ranked paths have passed valid controls: seld/jsonlint (252,371,311 downloads), laminas/laminas-json (35,102,503, forced own PHP Decoder), and halaxa/json-machine (30,443,415, own stream Parser plus ext/json member decoding).
uncertainty: Three PHP JSON third-party paths passed valid nested object controls and source-line coverage. Laminas and JSON Machine also passed a valid nested array control and stable source-line AFL feedback. Laminas is abandoned, and its own decoder runs only when explicitly enabled; its default API route delegates to ext/json. JSON Machine shares ext/json for member decoding. Five own-parser or partial-own-parser leads remain unverified; four json_decode wrappers are excluded. The bounded search used five Packagist queries of at most 100 hits each. Package downloads measure overall/historical adoption, not JSON parsing frequency. Valid controls do not establish complete RFC 8259 support.
